# Arcade fun Checklist: Arcade made fun: a more permissive recognition and five levels

**Purpose**: Test the quality of the written requirements (spec, plan, research, contracts, quickstart) of spec 014: the permissive recognition, the five levels, where they are chosen and remembered, the non-regression promises, and the honesty of the validation. Standard depth.
**Created**: 2026-10-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact (reviewer: the product owner). Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Defaults taken** (no input was given): standard depth, audience = the product owner as reviewer, focus = the permissive recognition and the levels, then non-regression and validation honesty.

## The permissive recognition

- [ ] CHK001 Is "more permissive" defined by the quantities that bound it (the clearly wrong notes accepted, the speed of the verdict) rather than by the adjective alone? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §SC-001, §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Is "a clearly wrong note" defined (which negative tests, which data) so that the 5 % limit can be checked by someone else? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-002, Research §R6]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the spec say what happens to the 5 % limit when the data already exceeds it (the built-in-microphone corpus already accepts 1 of 21 as a negative control with the default settings)? [Conflict, Research §R6]
- [ ] CHK004 Is "at least 20 % faster than Follow" stated on a named set of recordings and with a named statistic (median), and is the figure for Follow written as the base? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK005 Is it written that a note that is a semitone or more away can never be accepted, so that "a few more wrong notes" is understood as sounds within half a semitone? [Gap, Research §R2]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the three positions (like Practice, fun, very permissive) defined by their values, or is it written that the values are fixed by the measure and where they will be recorded? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Contract arcade-leniency §8]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the one-way rule (never stricter than the player's own effective settings) stated in the spec and not only in the plan and the contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Contract arcade-leniency §2]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the relation to the timing window of spec 012 unambiguous (on top of, capped at 200 ms, what a player already at 200 ms gets)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Research §R3]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the relation to a calibration profile (spec 013) written the same way in the spec, the plan and the contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK010 Is it stated that silence and very weak sounds are never accepted by the leniency (the level thresholds are not relaxed)? [Gap, Contract arcade-leniency §7]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "a verdict that does not wait for more certainty than the game needs" translated into a measurable requirement, or is it left to the speed figure only? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001]

## The five levels

- [ ] CHK012 Are the five levels listed with both shares in one place, without the wording of the first draft that said "chords" twice? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the rounding of a share to a whole number of sounds stated, with the rule for a piece too short to give one sound? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the "even spread" defined precisely enough that two implementations give the same sounds (the rank formula is in the plan, is it in the spec or the contract as a requirement)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Contract arcade-levels §3]
- [ ] CHK015 Is it defined which events count as notes and which as chords (the multi-note events with a pitch-changing effect, the events that are not judged)? [Gap, Contract arcade-levels §8, Research §R4]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the behaviour defined for a kept note whose legato origin was removed? [Edge Case, Contract arcade-levels §9]
- [ ] CHK017 Is it defined what the start in the middle of a piece (the caret) and the replay of a section keep of the level? [Coverage, Research §R4]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the score at a lower level explicitly not comparable with another level, and does the result say which level was played? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, §FR-010, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK019 Does the spec say whether the backing band and the unkept sounds of the player's track are heard or silent? [Ambiguity, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK020 Is "level 5 equals what the application gives today" tied to the leniency position in the same requirement, so that level 5 alone is not mistaken for non-regression? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, §SC-003]

## Choosing and remembering

- [ ] CHK021 Is it clear which launches offer the level choice (the Start button, the transport-bar button, the quick start, a restart, a replay)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Research §R7]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the consequence for a player who already uses Arcade (level 1 the first time) written, together with its being the owner's decision? [Assumption, Spec Edge Cases, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the fallback written for the case where the start window cannot take the level row (the plan's weaker alternative), and is it said that it needs the owner's agreement? [Dependency, Plan Complexity Tracking]
- [ ] CHK024 Are the default level and the default position written as two separate defaults that do not depend on each other? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK025 Is it stated when a changed level or position takes effect (the next run only), for every way of changing it? [Consistency, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the handling of an invalid saved value written for both the level and the position? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK027 Is it stated that nothing is added to the recognition settings file or to the Configuration page, so that a reader knows where the choices are visible? [Gap, Research §R5]

## Non-regression and scope

- [ ] CHK028 Is "Follow, Wait, the tuner and the calibration are unchanged" stated as a figure-level promise (0 differences) for every position, not only for the default? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the list of what is not touched (algorithms, backing band, route latency, scene drawing, technique judge) complete and consistent between the spec and the plan? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Research §R9]
- [ ] CHK030 Are the constraints of the existing source-structure tests on the Arcade start path recorded as a dependency, with the statement that no existing test is modified? [Dependency, Research §R8]

## Validation honesty

- [ ] CHK031 Is it said that the figures of SC-001 and SC-002 are measured and reported even when they fail, and what happens then (the owner decides)? [Completeness, Research §R6]
- [ ] CHK032 Is "the game is fun" kept as the owner's trial and not turned into a figure? [Clarity, Spec §SC-006, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the scope of every figure stated (this microphone, this guitar, the reference recording) so that no claim is made for other devices? [Gap, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK034 Is it stated what the headless tests cannot see (the feel of the levels, the readability of the new rows, the start window's layout on screen)? [Gap, Quickstart §7]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- Items that fail point to a requirement to write or sharpen in the spec, the plan or the tasks before `/speckit-implement`
- Number new items continuing from CHK034
